GB.headline: Fog likely to lead to some transport delays this morning
GB.description:
Areas of fog, dense in places with visibility below 100 metres at times, will slowly begin to thin, lift and clear later this morning or, in some spots, not until this afternoon.

For further details see https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/weather/warnings-and-advice/uk-warnings
